title: Code Folding (zf, zo, zc)
instruction_text:
Collapse and expand sections of text!

KEY COMMANDS:
'V' then select lines, then 'zf' = create fold from selection
'zo' = open fold under cursor
'zc' = close fold under cursor
'za' = toggle fold open/closed
'zR' = open ALL folds in file
'zM' = close ALL folds in file

Your task: Practice folding, then add DONE to the last line.

Steps:
1. Press 'j' to move to line 2 (START FOLD)
2. Press 'V' to enter visual line mode
3. Press '2j' to select 3 lines total (lines 2-4)
4. Press 'zf' to create a fold (lines collapse into one!)
5. Press 'zo' to open the fold (see lines again)
6. Press 'zc' to close it again
7. Press 'G' to go to last line
8. Press 'A' to append, type ' DONE', press ESC
9. Save with :wq

Tip: When folded, you'll see something like:
+--  3 lines: START FOLD-----
